points.K7: 管理控制：改变做事方式
points.K8: 个体防护是最后一道防线
points.K9: 靠防护挡住了，说明前面失守
points.K11: 用未遂事件修订作业危害分析

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一个五层倒三角图旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a large inverted triangle diagram divided into five colored layers with no text.
shots.narration: 这一课讲控制层级。
overlay: 控制层级：从源头管住危害

shots.scene: 倒三角五层依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: An inverted triangle with five blank colored layers lighting up one by one from top to bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 消除、替代、工程、管理、个体防护。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴上护目镜和手套，满意地拍拍胸口
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on safety goggles and gloves and pats his chest confidently.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：护目镜手套都戴了，够安全了。

shots.scene: 台面上杂物乱堆，试剂瓶摇摇欲坠
shots.prompt_en: A cluttered bench with reagent bottles stacked precariously near the edge and cables across the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 可他的台面乱糟糟，瓶子快掉下来了。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着放大镜看实验台
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot looks at a lab bench through a big magnifying glass.
shots.narration: 实验室里，很多事都可能出错。

shots.scene: 放大镜下浮现火焰、玻璃碎片、滴液图标
shots.prompt_en: Under a magnifying glass, icons appear: a small flame, broken glass and a dripping liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 要认出危害，预判会出什么错，

shots.scene: 一面盾牌罩住几个小人
shots.prompt_en: A large shield icon covering a small group of person pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 再尽一切可能保护自己和别人。

shots.section_title: 控制层级：越往上越有效
shots.scene: 欣欣指着倒三角图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a large inverted triangle diagram with five blank layers.
shots.narration: 有个保障安全的方法，叫控制层级。
overlay: 控制层级：越往上越有效

shots.section_title: 控制层级：越往上越有效
shots.scene: 倒三角图，箭头从上往下
shots.prompt_en: An inverted triangle with five blank layers, a big arrow beside it pointing from the wide top down to the narrow bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 从上到下，从最有效排到最不有效。

shots.scene: 三角最底层亮起护目镜、手套、实验服图标
shots.prompt_en: The narrow bottom layer of the inverted triangle lights up with icons of goggles, gloves and a lab coat. No people.
shots.narration: 先看最底下：个体防护装备。

shots.scene: 阿杰惊讶地张大嘴，抱着自己的护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks surprised with his mouth open, holding his goggles and fancy lab coat.
shots.narration: 阿杰吃惊：我的护目镜和实验服最没用？

shots.scene: 欣欣点点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods calmly with a small smile.
shots.narration: 没错。想想看就明白了。

shots.scene: 三角顶层亮起
shots.prompt_en: The top layer of the inverted triangle lights up in bright green. No people.
shots.narration: 从最上面看：能不能彻底消除危害？

shots.scene: 小研把杂物收进柜子，地上的电线理好
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts clutter away into cabinets and tidies cables off the floor.
shots.narration: 比如把东西收好，不会掉落、绊倒人。

shots.scene: 整洁的台面上打了一个大勾
shots.prompt_en: A clean, tidy lab bench with a big green check mark above it. No people.
shots.narration: 这显然是最好的选择。

shots.scene: 第二层亮起，腐蚀性瓶子换成肥皂
shots.prompt_en: The second layer of the triangle lights up; a bottle with a corrosion pictogram is swapped for a plain soap bottle along an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 能不能把危害换掉？

shots.scene: 黄色海绵上挤了绿色洗涤剂
shots.prompt_en: Green liquid soap squeezed onto a yellow sponge beside a sink. No people.
shots.narration: 比如以前用腐蚀性清洁剂，现在用肥皂。

shots.section_title: 工程控制：把人和危害隔开
shots.scene: 第三层亮起，人和危害之间出现一道透明挡板
shots.prompt_en: The third layer lights up; a clear barrier appears between a person pictogram and a hazard icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不能消除替代，就把人和危险隔开。
overlay: 工程控制：把人和危害隔开

shots.section_title: 工程控制：把人和危害隔开
shots.scene: 小研在安全柜视窗后操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works behind the glass sash of a lab safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 这叫工程控制：用物理手段挡在中间。

shots.section_title: 工程控制：把人和危害隔开
shots.scene: 新生儿保温箱，戴手套的手从圆孔伸进去
shots.prompt_en: A hospital infant incubator with a sleeping cartoon baby inside; the older man's gloved hands reach in through the round hand ports.
shots.narration: 就像新生儿保温箱上的手套孔。

shots.section_title: 工程控制：把人和危害隔开
shots.scene: 欣欣捧着脸，露出被萌到的表情
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds its cheeks with an adoring expression, small hearts floating around.
shots.narration: 大人照顾宝宝时，宝宝也被保护着。

shots.section_title: 管理控制：改变做事方式
shots.scene: 第四层亮起，日程表和流程图图标
shots.prompt_en: The fourth layer lights up with icons of a calendar and a simple flowchart. No people.
shots.narration: 管理控制排得靠下，但依然关键。
overlay: 管理控制：改变做事方式

shots.section_title: 管理控制：改变做事方式
shots.scene: 老周调整空白排班表和流程
shots.prompt_en: The older man rearranges a blank schedule board and a blank procedure chart.
shots.narration: 它改变流程、排班和各种程序，

shots.section_title: 管理控制：改变做事方式
shots.scene: 时钟、次数、刻度三个图标都在变小
shots.prompt_en: Three icons shrinking: a clock, a tally counter and a level gauge, each with a down arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 减少接触危害的频次、时长和程度。

shots.section_title: 个体防护是最后一道防线
shots.scene: 最底层个体防护托着整个三角
shots.prompt_en: The bottom tip of the inverted triangle glows as if holding up the whole stack. No people.
shots.narration: 再说回个体防护，所谓最不有效，
overlay: 个体防护是最后一道防线

shots.section_title: 个体防护是最后一道防线
shots.scene: 一面小盾牌挡在人前
shots.prompt_en: A small shield stands right in front of a person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 其实是说，它是最后一道防线。

shots.section_title: 靠防护挡住了，说明前面失守
shots.scene: 前面四道墙都有缺口，只剩最后一道盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Four walls with gaps in them, and only the last small shield blocking a flying droplet icon. No people.
shots.narration: 真靠它保护了你，说明前面都失效了，
overlay: 靠防护挡住了，说明前面失守

shots.section_title: 靠防护挡住了，说明前面失守
shots.scene: 空白事故报告单
shots.prompt_en: A blank incident report form with a pen and a yellow warning triangle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这可能已经是需要上报的事故了。

shots.scene: 小研挑选手套和护目镜并正确穿戴
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student chooses gloves and goggles from a shelf and puts them on properly.
shots.narration: 但防护装备选得对、穿得好，

shots.scene: 护目镜挡住飞溅的液滴图标
shots.prompt_en: Close view of safety goggles blocking a splash of droplets, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 多半能安然脱身，

shots.scene: 阿杰松了口气，头顶亮起灯泡
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sighs with relief, a light bulb icon above his head.
shots.narration: 只老了一两秒，还长了不少见识。

shots.section_title: 用未遂事件修订作业危害分析
shots.scene: 试剂瓶差点从台边掉下被接住的示意图
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bottle tipping off a bench edge and being caught just in time, with an exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 未遂事件和事故，
overlay: 用未遂事件修订作业危害分析

shots.section_title: 用未遂事件修订作业危害分析
shots.scene: 报告单飞向一个盾牌机构图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank report form flying toward a blank government shield emblem icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不只是报给美国职业安全卫生管理局。

shots.section_title: 用未遂事件修订作业危害分析
shots.scene: 小研在电脑上修改空白分析表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student revises a blank hazard analysis sheet on a computer.
shots.narration: 还要借这次经历，修订作业危害分析。

shots.scene: 阿杰举手向老周提问
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand to ask the older man a question.
shots.narration: 不知道作业危害分析？那就问导师。

shots.scene: 实验室成员围成一圈讨论
shots.prompt_en: Lab members including the older man, the female graduate student and the young male student stand in a circle discussing.
shots.narration: 一次失误、一位成员，大家一起学。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现倒三角
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a floating inverted triangle with five blank layers.
shots.narration: 先消除，再替代，然后工程和管理。

shots.scene: 盾牌图标在三角底部
shots.prompt_en: A small shield icon glowing at the bottom tip of the inverted triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 个体防护是最后一道防线，要选对穿好。

shots.scene: 报告单和分析表两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a blank report form and a blank hazard analysis sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 从每次未遂中学习，修订危害分析。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在整洁台面前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera in front of a tidy lab bench.
shots.narration: 从源头管住危害，下次见！
